evidence_direction_note: SD-MEL-PRODUCER produces a graded, above-reference waking MEL load that is REDUCIBLE (post-shift PE decays under training on the ARM_1_LOW anchor) while the matched, at-least-as-elevated noise control does not. The test-bed is validated as a novelty producer. This licenses the SEPARATE, still-gated MECH-180 ecological end-to-end run; it is NOT itself MECH-180 evidence.

preconditions.name: world_model_converged_frozen_probe
preconditions.description: recon-only P0 base converges on the FIXED frozen probe battery on at least SEED_PASS_FRAC of seeds (readiness R2)
preconditions.control: fraction of seeds whose stable-base P0 conv_rel_drop clears MIN_REL_CONV_DROP; same seed-fraction statistic `met` tests

preconditions.name: frozen_pe_responds_to_shock
preconditions.description: on the converged frozen base, PE rises under a max-novelty shock (readiness R1) -- the instrument can move at all
preconditions.control: SHOCK_DRIFT positive control vs STABLE_DRIFT, ready seeds. This is also the SAME KIND of relative-PE-reduction statistic C4's decay_frac routes on, measured on a positive control

preconditions.name: learnability_quartiles_populated
preconditions.description: the first and last cycle quartiles both carry enough samples for the C4 decay comparison to be readable, on every cell of the anchor/control pair. THIS IS THE 798 DEFECT: there its top bin held 0 samples by construction
preconditions.control: worst cell of ARM_1_LOW and ARM_4_NOISE_LO over quartile 0 and quartile 3

preconditions.name: noise_control_at_least_as_elevated
preconditions.description: the selected negative control's MEL is at least the anchor's on EVERY seed, so the C4 decay comparison is fair-or-conservative rather than won by the graded arm simply having more PE. 798 failed this at sigma 0.05
preconditions.control: ARM_4_NOISE_LO mel / ARM_1_LOW mel, worst seed

preconditions.name: cycle_quartiles_reachable_by_construction
preconditions.description: design-time proof that every quartile is non-empty on every shift-enabled arm: the counter cycles 0..interval-1, so N_BINS quartiles are all reachable when interval >= N_BINS. Asserted from the pre-registered ARMS table before any compute is spent
